verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own condition-triggered automation: impact-metric safeguards can automatically advance rollout milestones, pause rollouts, or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold (e.g., error rate or latency). However, this automation is limited to release-management rollouts. The evidence shows no general rule engine that lets users define arbitrary event triggers and actions. Scheduled change requests are time-based one-off applications, not event rules. Missing for 10: a general user-defined event→action rule system beyond rollout safeguards, documentation of which events and actions are available, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
